speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you today. To begin, how long has it been since your birth, and are you currently experiencing any specific symptoms or difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since you have no immunization records, have you received the Vitamin K injection and the first dose of the Hepatitis B vaccine? Additionally, are you experiencing any jaundice, poor feeding, or lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The clinical triad of cataracts (cloudy lenses), sensorineural deafness (failed auditory screening), and a continuous heart murmur (likely a Patent Ductus Arteriosus), combined with the non-blanching cutaneous findings, is diagnostic for this condition.
